# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Blames Adam for His Fall

---

**1** 'And because of you, Adam, I was cast down from the heavens to this earth, and my grief is upon you.'

**2** Adam said to him: 'What is my fault? It was not I who did this, but God alone. Why have you set your evil upon me?'

**3** The devil answered: 'I have set my evil on you because it is through you that I was expelled. God your Lord gave you all things and created everything for your sake. It is because of you that I was driven out and exiled from my home.'

**4** 'When you were established in paradise, I was cast out. I said in my heart: "If he is to live in happiness while I am in exile and sorrow, I will make him suffer so that he too may be exiled as I am."'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
